title: Binance Pay Expands Sending Options to Simplify Crypto Transfers
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We are thrilled to introduce two exciting upgrades to Binance Pay Send, designed to make sending crypto easier, faster, and more secure than ever before. Binance Pay now offers Send via Contact and Send On-Chain — two powerful new ways to transfer crypto that cater to different user needs and preferences. Binance Pay Send via Contact Send crypto instantly to your phone contacts without typing wallet addresses, emails, or Binance IDs. Choose from over 300 cryptocurrencies and enjoy zero gas fees. Time-Saving Convenience:  Simply select a contact from your phone book within the Binance App and send crypto with just a few taps. Reduced Errors:  Say goodbye to manually entering payment details or copying and pasting information. Choose recipients directly from verified contacts and minimize the risk of sending funds to incorrect addresses. Stronger Social Connectivity:  Effortlessly connect with friends and family, strengthening your crypto network and making transfers between Binance users more social and intuitive. Binance Pay Send On-Chain Send crypto on-chain by simply scanning a QR code or snapping a photo of a wallet address. No manual input or network hassles. AI-Powered Convenience:  Automatically extract payment details from images or screenshots using AI-powered OCR, reducing manual input time and speeding up transactions. Enhanced Accuracy and Security:  Minimize errors with character similarity highlights and secondary confirmation for new addresses, ensuring safer payments. On-Chain Payments Enablement:  Facilitates widespread adoption of stablecoins by simplifying on-chain transactions. How to Use Binance Pay Send via Contact  Step 1: Login to your Binance App and select  [Pay]  from the homepage top right icon. Step 2: Go to  [Send]  and tap the  [Contacts]  button. Step 3: Allow Binance to access your phone contacts by tapping  [Continue]. Step 4: Select the contact you want to send crypto to and tap  [Continue] . Step 5: Choose the cryptocurrency and enter the amount. Step 6: Confirm the transaction details and complete security identifications to authorize. * If your contact does not have a Binance account, invite them to join using the sign up link. * If your contact has a Binance account but did not register with their phone number, request their Binance User ID (BUID) / email address and send crypto via these instead. Binance Pay Send On-chain Step 1: Login to your Binance App and select  [Pay]  from the homepage top right icon. Step 2: Select  [Send On-chain] . Step 3: Scan or snap a photo of the recipient’s wallet QR code or address. Step 4: Enter the amount and complete security identifications to confirm your transfer. * Please note that Binance Pay may not be available in certain restricted countries/regions, depending on legal and regulatory requirements.  Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-07-03
